lines.en: I take leave on Friday.
I'm fine. I want to relax.
lines.zh: 我没有生病，只是想放松一下。

lines.en: In the morning, I sleep late.
I go to the shop with my friend.
I want to return a pair of shoes.
The shoes are too small for me.
"Can I get a bigger size?"
"Sure. Do you have the receipt?"
I have the receipt in my bag.
My friend and I see a black dress.
lines.zh: 我和朋友看到一条黑色的裙子。

lines.en: It's very nice, and very expensive!
We go home and have porridge.

dialogue.title: 跟老板请假
dialogue.setting: 星期三下午，Amy 去老板 Mr Lee 的办公室，想请星期五的假。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Can I speak to you for a moment?

lines.speaker: Mr Lee
lines.en: Sure, Amy. Come in.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Can I take leave on Friday?

lines.speaker: Mr Lee
lines.en: On Friday? Are you OK?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: No, I'm fine. My friend has a wedding.
lines.zh: 没有，我很好。我朋友要结婚。

lines.speaker: Mr Lee
lines.en: Nice! Who can cover your class?
lines.zh: 哦，真好！谁可以代你的课？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Jason can cover my class.

lines.speaker: Mr Lee
lines.en: Good. And the parents?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I have called all the parents.
lines.zh: 我已经给所有家长打过电话了。

lines.speaker: Mr Lee
lines.en: Very good. Is there anything else?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes. Can I leave early today, too?
lines.zh: 有。我今天也可以早点走吗？

lines.speaker: Mr Lee
lines.en: Today, too?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I'm a bit dizzy. I need to see a doctor.
lines.zh: 我有点头晕，需要去看医生。

lines.speaker: Mr Lee
lines.en: OK, go and rest. Send me your MC.
lines.zh: 好，去休息吧。把病假单发给我。
